blurb: Guests fish local waters of the Indian and Banana River systems for species like snook, tarpon, redfish, and trout on inshore trips. Offshore trips target pelagic species such as king mackerel, mahi, blackfin tuna, and bottom fish like groupers and snappers. Trips vary in duration and offer opportunities for all skill levels.
extraNote: Additional $50 fee for 4th passenger on inshore half day and full day trips
